verdict.rationale: Windmill's docs show unattended background automation in depth. Schedules pair CRON expressions with error and recovery handlers (docs-18), and event triggers include webhooks, Kafka, Postgres, SQS, MQTT and more (docs-15). Steps can retry automatically (docs-13), workflows get checkpointing and fault tolerance (docs-5), and AI agent steps can be embedded in flows (docs-20). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled or triggered automations run reliably in the background in practice.
